propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail, surfacing as an INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets in the same relation graph walk

Empty ticket directories created by incomplete writes persist invisibly to git (git cannot track empty directories) and remain in local clones even after pull, blocking plan reviews until manually removed
The reducer failure names the broken orphan ticket, not the ticket being reviewed, creating wrong-direction debugging signals
Orphan event-less directories result from process death mid-write during the makedirs-to-atomic-rename window and cannot be safely cleaned by the writer under concurrent multi-session store access
The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less ticket directories by skipping them with a warning rather than failing the entire snapshot
